pages.name: Magma Bee
pages.text: Bubba Star. Nether, all the time.

Its hive can sit on magma: fire-immune bees path through fire and lava safely.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() Magma Block$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() Basalt Deltas, Nether Wastes$(br2)$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Magma Honeycomb: every trip, 210 per hive-hour

$(l)Lava filler:$() Each time it flies over a cauldron there is a 25% chance it adds a quarter of lava. A full lava cauldron takes four. Other mods can pump the lava out (250 mB per quarter).$(br2)$(l)Fire-immune:$() Fire and lava don't hurt it.
Use it on a vanilla bee.
